title: AI, software, scientific instrumentation and complex systems
introduction: I support technical projects from requirements definition through to deliverable validation. My background combines team coordination, scientific understanding, technical decision-making and direct development work when the project requires it.

sections.title: Three dimensions of one profile
items: R&D project management — Scoping, requirements analysis, specifications, roadmaps, multidisciplinary coordination, risk management, quality, funding and validation.
Software and artificial intelligence — Python and TypeScript development, generative AI integration, machine learning, data analysis, interfaces and automation.
Instrumentation and complex systems — Creation of laboratories and experimental platforms, microscopy, microfluidics, electronics, prototyping and control software.

sections.title: Practical information
items: Primarily open to permanent employment opportunities.
Available for hybrid or fully remote work.
Available for occasional travel to client or partner sites.
Professional working proficiency in French and English.
